dimensions.assessment: Affects primarily state transportation departments and members of the existing federal Advisory Committee on Human Trafficking.
dimensions.evidence: expands the membership for the committee to not more than 16 external stakeholder members (from 15) and requires the committee to include a representative from state departments of transportation
